Definition: an achastarite (i.e. courier); the designation (rather than name) of an Israelite
BiblicalUsage: Haahashtari — the Achashtari — is named once, as a son of Naarah in the genealogy of Judah. The verse gives his brothers' names and nothing more. He is one of the many whose whole biblical record is a single line in a family list.
TheologicalSignificance: A single name in a genealogy teaches nothing by itself, and it stands in the record only because the Chronicler kept Judah's families.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
